## Which file do I download?

| File | What it is |
|------|------------|
| `KnackeredTV-Installer-<version>.exe` | **Installer (recommended).** Installs KnackeredTV, adds Start menu and desktop shortcuts, and can be uninstalled normally. |
| `KnackeredTV-Portable-<version>.exe` | **Portable.** No install needed: run it from anywhere, such as a USB stick. |
| `KnackeredTV-Android-<version>.apk` | **Android phone or Android TV.** Sideload it (allow "install unknown apps"); newer APKs update an installed copy. |

Your profile, favorites and settings are kept in `%APPDATA%\knackeredtv` for both versions.

Builds are unsigned, so Windows SmartScreen may warn on first run: click **More info**, then **Run anyway**. Check the SHA-256 hashes in the release assets against a [VirusTotal](https://www.virustotal.com) scan if you want to verify a file.
